scope: P5 sampling DESIGN ONLY — execution is deferred to a separate gate. Build sample roster + rubric + label + branching conditions for human-judged semantic-gain spot check.
essential_question: metadata that mechanically utilized inside the generator: does the resulting explanation actually feel better to a human reader, or only mechanically richer?

claim_boundary.mechanical_recovery_claim: already locked at 13/13 from previous gate — NOT a P5 claim

sample_groups.selection_strategy: year-span diversity (1998 / 2000 / 2004 × 2 / 2008) to capture variation in raw solution wording while breaker dl is identical across all 13
sample_groups.purpose: Does cross_subject_expansion to 회로이론 actually help the human reader, or feel forced?

sample_groups.selection_strategy: one per (slot, item) unique key for slot/item diversity

samples.dl: 전력 중성점 접지 -> 회로 대칭분 해석
전력 단락전류 -> 회로 옴의 법칙 -> 회로 임피던스 환산
samples.rationale: 차단기의 closest neighbor (회로 임피던스 환산 영역 공유) — 비교 유용

samples.dl: 전력 코로나/표피효과 -> 회로 분포정수 -> 회로 임피던스

sample_groups.purpose: regression 0 (mechanical) is locked; human spot-check whether non-breaker outputs remain stable in feel

sample_groups.selection_strategy: slot/item diversity within the limited 5 unique (slot, item) keys (전력_함정S 2 + 전력_설비고장 3)
sample_groups.purpose: Does dl-null + enriched metadata alone produce reasonable explanations, or does the absence of cross_subject_expansion noticeably hurt?

rubric.question: Is the explanation easier to understand for a candidate studying this question?
Does the 회로이론 link (when present) genuinely help connect concepts the learner already has?
rubric.direction: higher is better, but conditional on link presence

rubric.question: Does the cross-subject expansion feel forced/decorative rather than substantive?
Is the wrong-choice analysis more specific to the trap pattern vs generic phrasing?
Are core_extraction.phenomenon / trap_pattern / distractor_analysis.trap_type useful study cues?
Does the abundance of metadata make the explanation cluttered or harder to scan?

labels.B_better: B output is clearly more useful for the learner
labels.same: Difference negligible; mechanical change does not register as a quality shift
labels.B_worse: B output is actually less useful — cross_subject_expansion or metadata harms clarity
labels.needs_human_review: Automated rubric application yields ambiguous result — escalate to deeper human review

branching_conditions.decision: B-only patch maintains semantic value; A1c not needed
mechanical recovery succeeded but semantic gain is weak — investigate generator utilization or P5 template
cross-subject link may degrade clarity; review whether to revert dl patch or refine link rendering
81 regression 0 aligns with human spot check; no further action on non-breaker
10-field semantic-field diff missed a quality regression; widen audit scope
dl-null entries benefit insufficiently from enriched metadata alone; queue separate metadata-only audit

execution_steps_when_authorized: Step 1: For each of 12 samples, side-by-side read baseline output_NNN.json (v_next_results_d3/) and B output_NNN.json (v_next_results_d3_b/) plus the corresponding input.md from each manifest version
Step 2: Apply 6-axis rubric per sample. Record per-axis 1-5 score or N/A
Step 3: Per sample, assign one of 4 labels based on rubric outcome
Step 4: Aggregate per group: majority label per group
Step 5: Map group results to branching conditions, derive next-state recommendation
Step 6: Report sample-level findings + group-level aggregation + recommended next gate
must_not_do_in_design_phase: Execute side-by-side reading or apply rubric — that is the execution gate
Commit, push, or write DEVLOG/Vault/MEMORY/decision JSONL

final_status_options.READY_FOR_P5_SAMPLING_EXECUTION_GATE: Sample roster + rubric + labels + branching all in place; execution can begin on user authorization
final_status_options.NEEDS_P5_SAMPLING_DESIGN_FIX: Design has gaps or ambiguous criteria; redesign needed before execution
final_status_options.BLOCKED_BY_MISSING_SAMPLE_MAPPING: baseline/B file paths cannot be deterministically mapped for one or more selected samples

rationale_for_selection: All 12 samples have deterministic NNN-based mapping to both baseline and B outputs. Rubric is concrete (6 axes), labels are discrete (4 categories), branching conditions enumerate 6 next-state pathways. Execution can begin on user-authorized P5 execution gate.
